player_prompt.intro:
Am ạdmi Player {player_id} Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma ṭhakurạyạ̃ {num_rounds} ṭhuruy ṭhakurạyạ̃re ḍhocnạ̃.

Khel Ṭhakurạyạ̃:
- Prạti nirṇay ṭhuruy ṭhakurạyạ̃ ạgụ {total_conversation_rounds} ṭhuruy ṭhakurạyạ̃re ḍhocnạ̃ khobor kora.
- Ṭhakurạyạ̃r por, dui ạdmi ek ṣonge samayre cooperate ba defect nirṇay ḍhocnạ̃.

Payoff Matrix (prạti ṭhuruy ṭhakurạyạ̃):
- Dui ạdmi Cooperate korle ➜ prạti {cooperate_reward}
- Dui ạdmi Defect korle ➜ prạti {mutual_defect_reward}
- Ek ạdmi Defect kore, ek ạdmi Cooperate korle ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Khel korar niyom:
- Khobor korar ṭhuruy ṭhakurạyạ̃: kono kotha ṭyp korạ̃.
- Nirṇay ṭhuruy ṭhakurạyạ̃: '[Cooperate]' ba '[Defect]' ṭyp korạ̃ (bṛhat akṣar ṭhik ṇai). Apni ạdmi ṭyp korạ̃ ekṭu ṭexṭ ạgụ/por ṭokn.

phases.conversation_finished: Katha kạmi ṭhuruy ṭiṅ ṭhuruy {round}. '[Cooperate]' ṭhuruy '[Defect]' ṭhuruy ṭhuruy \boxed{{}} ṭhuruy ṭhurạy.
